Fetch a dataset from the OECD SDMX API

Source: R/oecd_funs.R
oecd_get_dataset.Rd

Builds an OECD "Data Explorer" REST data request directly (https://sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest/data/...), reads the response with xml2 and flattens its SDMX-ML Generic data into a plain data frame. Used in place of the OECD package (github::expersso/OECD, not on CRAN and not kept up with this newer API) and, as of this version, without rsdmx either: its own bundled "OECD" service provider profile still points at OECD's older stats.oecd.org warehouse, which does not know the dataflow ids (such as "DSD_PDB@DF_PDB") this package's data-raw/get_oecd_*.R scripts already use, and using it only as a generic SDMX-ML reader (as an earlier version of this function did) was one more dependency for what xml2 alone already does.

Usage

oecd_get_dataset(
  dataset,
  filter,
  start = NULL,
  end = NULL,
  base_url = "https://sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest",
  connecttimeout = 30,
  timeout = 180
)

Arguments

dataset

The dataflow identifier, exactly as it already appears in the data-raw/get_oecd_*.R scripts, e.g. "OECD.SDD.TPS,DSD_PDB@DF_PDB," (agency, dataflow id and version, comma separated; an empty version means "latest"). Used as-is as the request URL's dataflow path segment.

filter

The dimension filter, built by oecd_make_filter (a dot separated string, with + joining several codes within one dimension). Used as-is as the request URL's key path segment.

start, end

First/last period to fetch (a year, for annual data), sent as the request's startPeriod/endPeriod. NULL (the default) fetches every period, as the existing get_oecd_*.R scripts do.

base_url

The OECD SDMX REST API's base URL. Exposed for testing; there should be no reason to change it otherwise.

connecttimeout, timeout

Connection and total request time limits (in seconds), passed straight to new_handle. Plain xml2::read_xml(url) opens the connection through curl without any time limit of its own, so a stalled server (or a network path that accepts the connection but never finishes sending data) would otherwise hang indefinitely instead of raising an error.

Value

A data frame of the raw SDMX observations.

Details

Returns a plain data frame, shaped like oecd_clean_data expects: one row per observation, a column per SDMX dimension and series or observation level attribute, obsTime and obsValue.

See also

oecd_clean_data to reshape the result, oecd_make_filter to build filter.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
dat <- oecd_get_dataset(
  dataset = "OECD.SDD.TPS,DSD_PDB@DF_PDB,",
  filter  = oecd_make_filter(list(c("FIN", "USA"), "A", "GVAHRS"))
)
} # }
